Sam (net-arch): quick sync: after the v2 control-plane RFC, we need a low-risk cutover plan for private endpoints that avoids doubled egress and preserves src-ip for NATed customers.
Tara (infra): +1. Ops constraint: some customers require src-ip stability for ACLs. What can we guarantee?
Sam (net-arch): plan: short dual-advertise window + signed affinity tokens to pin active flows. Default affinity_ttl=120s; per-tenant override.
Lee (onboarding): can we add a per-tenant toggle exposed via API and a CLI opt-out? e.g., `rctl tenant set-migration T123 --mode off`.
Sam (net-arch): yes. Safety rule: if v2 handshake fails 4x, server pins tenant to v1 for 10m and emits metric `cp_v2_fallbacks_total`.
Priya (eng-sre): metrics: `cp_v2_attempts_total`, `cp_v2_fallbacks_total`, `cp_v2_handshake_ms` (histogram). Alert when >0.6% tenants fallback over 10m. Add probe for token refresh latency.
Marco (product): customer-facing note: "No planned downtime; long-lived sessions may see short IP continuity changes. Contact SE for strict ACLs." Include FAQ.
Tara (infra): token details: v2 uses short-lived signed route tokens (5-6m). We'll ship a tiny token-renewer binary for on-prem installs (health endpoint + socket output) and use the relay-agent in cloud.
Lee (onboarding): CLI will include `--dry-run` to simulate handshakes and `--pilot` to run with a small tenant set.
deploy-bot: token-renewer v0.1 build started -> staging (sha: f9d3a1)
Sam (net-arch): migration steps (high-level): 1) set migration_mode=canary 2) deploy token-renewer/relay 3) dual-push DNS (apex TTL=45s, duration 8m) 4) monitor metrics -> promote or pause.
Priya (eng-sre): runbook: pause if fallback >0.6% for 10m; rollback = set migration_mode=off + purge affinity cache.
Sam (net-arch): action owners: token spec (Sam), renewer (Tara/Lee), metrics+alerts (Priya), docs+email (Marco). Will draft RFC addendum with sequence diagram.
